_doc: Render massing for the historic town hall, read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of GRB footprint 1744586, the whole complex), u along 'axis_deg' = 22 (the market facade), v towards the back (north-west). The facade runs u -10.6..29.7 at v = -21; DHMV II across it: eaves ~12.5 m, ridge ~17 m at v = -16, back wings 12-15 m flat or low. Shape checked by eye against photos of the square (look-up only, AGENTS.md rule 1): white stone facade with corbelled corner turrets, a steep slate saddle roof with dormers, a slender slate ridge turret.
